questions.prompt: Which claim is currently working, and which alternatives remain contested?
Which claim was retracted, and what remains inspectable?
Which claims are suspect but not yet rebuilt?
Is this view current, stale, or outside coverage?
What exact evidence, scope, hashes, tier, and constraints will this approval bind?
Which external commit changed state, and what speculative branch was preserved?
What capability and dependency changes does this candidate add or remove?
What checkpoint does this undo fork from, and which descendants remain?
Which decisions are grouped by intent and deadline, and which evidence is shared?
Can every critical graph state be recovered from the accessibility tree or text fallback?
